{/* Generated from docs/templates/mcp/overview.mdx — do not edit directly. */}

The Calibrate [MCP server](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) exposes the public
API as tools for coding agents like Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex — so they can
list agents, resolve names to UUIDs, run tests, and poll results without leaving
your editor. Every tool maps 1-to-1 to a [public API](/api-reference/introduction)
operation.

## Install

```bash
npx -y @dalmia/calibrate-mcp start --api-key-auth sk_your_api_key
```

## Auth

Create an API key under [**Workspace settings → API keys**](https://calibrate.artpark.ai/workspace-settings?tab=api-keys) — see the [API keys guide](/reference/api-keys). Pass it with `--api-key-auth` or the `CALIBRATE_API_KEY_AUTH` environment variable.

## Connect your editor

<CodeGroup>

```json Cursor
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "calibrate": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@dalmia/calibrate-mcp", "start"],
      "env": {
        "CALIBRATE_API_KEY_AUTH": "sk_your_api_key"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```bash Claude Code
claude mcp add calibrate -- npx -y @dalmia/calibrate-mcp start --api-key-auth sk_your_api_key
```

</CodeGroup>

Once connected, ask your agent to list agents, resolve names to UUIDs, run tests, or poll run status.

## Self-hosting

For self-hosted Calibrate deployments, pass `--server-url` to point the server at your API instance:

```bash
npx -y @dalmia/calibrate-mcp start \
  --api-key-auth "$CALIBRATE_API_KEY_AUTH" \
  --server-url https://calibrate.my-company.internal
```

## Tools

The tool pages under this tab list every available tool, grouped by resource,
with its arguments and a link to the underlying API operation.
